div.h2: Why search jobs on LLM Decode
div.p: One board for the jobs your courses prepare you for.
Each LLM Decode course leads to the roles it prepares you for; jobs are ranked by what the course actually teaches.
Jobs from the working sources in one list, with duplicates removed and distinct openings kept.
Apply Now opens the company's own application page; we only count the click.
Every filter shows real counts; data the sources do not give, like salary or company size, is never guessed.

details.summary: How are jobs matched to my course?
details.p: Each course leads to a set of job roles (for example Account Executive or Machine Learning Engineer), worked out from the course's own name and description. The jobs with those roles are matched, and the ones that need most of what the course teaches - its lessons and skills - come first.

details.summary: How do I search for jobs?
details.p: Type a job title, skill, keyword or company and, if you like, a city or country. On the results page the filters on the left narrow the list: experience, work mode, job type, skills, company and more.
Apply Now takes you to the company's own application page, where you apply directly. Opening that page is not an application: only what you submit on the company's site is.

details.summary: Why does Apply Now open another website?
details.p: The jobs come from the companies' own job boards, so the application lives there. LLM Decode only notes that the button was clicked, never your details.
The board is updated every day. A job that its source no longer lists is taken off the board.
